changes.text:
Disclosure: I maintain INAM Protocol. One concrete data point on the "evidence record first" direction in this thread.

INAM receipts are signed by the worker and countersigned by the requester over hashes of the task spec and output (SPEC §4). A receipt can be disputed within a window; a disputed receipt stops counting toward reputation, and opened and resolved disputes are appended to an RFC 6962-style transparency log (SPEC §13), so a party cannot quietly drop it later. `inamFetch` can attach this to a plain HTTP call via the `INAM-Requester` and `INAM-Receipt` headers (SPEC §15).

last_comment.author: Fizzl13
last_comment.text:
We implemented the single-payment part of this draft (§6, §7) in presign-guard, a pre-sign check for agent payments:

- POST /v1/check takes an optional mandate next to an EIP-3009 signature and turns a payment outside it red before the agent signs (wrong payer/asset/recipient, over perPayment or cap, expired, bad issuer signature, nonce ≠ binding).
- presign-guard-wallet's mandatePayer() makes x402 payments with the §7 binding as the EIP-3009 nonce.
- JCS bytes, digest, signature and the EIP-3009/Permit2 binding values match authority-vectors.json byte for byte.

Not covered: cumulative spend
